summary: Opened WPR106-53 for a focused operator/research UI logic reliability audit covering route/action contracts, templates, stale labels, guard consistency, and focused validation.

Subagent and local review found concrete UI/route reliability issues: logout CSRF short-circuiting, mutating-route JSON 500s, live-boundary checks only at queue time, unauthenticated full health snapshots, stale prediction labels, missing command debounce/error states, symbol-mismatched research evidence selection, misleading standalone manifest links, and expensive research UI scans through trials.

Hardened operator route parsing and CSRF, redacted public health details, rechecked research job boundary at worker time, bounded artifact and research UI scans, added visible/debounced browser action failure states, routed the evidence bundle through BTC/ETH autopilot, symbol-scoped analysis/eligibility evidence selection, and updated standalone research boundary links.

Validation passed: inline script parse check, python -m compileall -q src/tradingbotsuite, pytest tests/contracts -q (441 passed), focused UI/health/research UI set (20 passed), broad operator/engine set (221 passed), and full python -m pytest tests -q (1561 passed, 1 skipped, 1 XGBoost environment warning).
